title: Zephyr: B.2.2 Time-Based Expiry
description: Implement packet deadline enforcement: routing 5s, ACK/NACK 10s, app data configurable 60s default.
notes: Acceptance already satisfied in current tree: tx_queue_push_default_deadline maps routing to 20x250ms=5s, ACK/NACK priority to 40x250ms=10s, and application traffic to 240x250ms=60s; tx_queue_push accepts caller-supplied absolute deadlines for configurable application expiry.
